text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! That wasn't a yawn just now! I was 
trying to say... 'Faaanfare'!

"Come to think of it, I think she 
mentioned there would be a quiz soon."

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Geez! You really have such sharp 
intuition at the weirdest times...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm never gonna yawn again! Just you 
watch!

Even as she said that, Daiwa Scarlet was 
desperately trying to hold back a yawn.
